method: Original attach composition executes in Unicorn including finalize, body append, group removal, merge, absorb and link append; body removal 0x1957fc0, growth 0x19582a0/0x1958380, allocator global 0x1433365b8 slots and the group destructor are authored deterministic services. The model is engine.pose_island_attach.bind_island_attach on PoseFlatMemory with finalize/append/removal delegated to the existing reconstructed modules. The C6 publish loop is then run on both resulting pending spans.
comparisons: ordered service events (body removal, growth, allocator, destroy, publication) with arguments
every byte of context, lists, groups, bodies, metadata, links, poses, arrays and service-allocated storage
coverage: 0..6 changed links with flag bit1 skips
ordinary groups in both context lists (flag 0/1), special 0x408/0x410 groups
metadata bit15 gates, special-group body moves, merges with ties and swaps
finalize pending-link queueing by first-endpoint kind nibble 2 after the entry clear
growth of body/link vectors and pose arrays through alloc, realloc and zero-capacity paths
limits: Body removal 0x1957fc0 (constraint pruning, link clear, payload pool) supplied by an authored swap-remove.
Growth and allocator are authored; native allocation/failure not covered.
Synthetic topology; no live capture; no lock or concurrency semantics.
